facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit - pressure exposure at V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during shift handover while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 1 April 2009 a near hit was recorded on V-4110, PSV-4110 and PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
